quote: Recently, neutralized summarization was proposed to mitigate media bias by generating a neutralized summary given multiple articles that frame the same story from liberal or conservative viewpoints.
This paper aims to generate a neutralized summary given multiple articles with differing ideological bias as input, thereby mitigating their framing bias.
